title: Add timeout to other MetricsProvider fetches (if any)
body: If MetricsProvider gains additional fetch calls (e.g., for different endpoints), ensure they also use the AbortController+timeout pattern.
rationale: Consistency — the same bug pattern could reappear in new fetch calls

title: Consider generic fetchWithTimeout utility
body: A shared fetchWithTimeout utility in a utils file could be reused across the codebase for all fetch calls that need timeout protection.
rationale: Reuse — other components may need the same timeout pattern
